label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Carm et Lodhan
english: I.2 · The Cry of the Bonded

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et grem hosast, ul sestow et kiser hosast.
english: *The first winter, after the first assault.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: En drenn sost, eth et hosast sa re hadhom fedh; et pawast sa re hunn et odh sy. Ul et orl sa wrodhom umo, re yal delv grem lom, eth ew tev et Stonwrytan en.
english: *Mine own, and the first tale that ever I laid; this hearth had heard but one before it. On the day I tell of I was twelve winters old, and a child of the guild.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess sy re yal ludal wrodhol umom, eth re hadha Halyna en narlath pana um et tolm.
english: Tonight I was afraid to speak, and {{Halyna}} laid my two hands on the stone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm.
english: "Hold the stone."

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth o, eth es geth tho.
english: "Hold it, and it will hold thee."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull kethym o.
english: So I hold it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh orl et movenn, re resk et Stonwrytan ul linth et parow hemm, merr lesk murr hyor, eth et bresketh ul ol simmeth. Re sol et baegyth dasken um et sulv, bynt hosen vorrdhuss. Um et hald re harmant et hesperdeth dem et movenn. Ul et linth re vysker nayalat.
english: At dusk on the day of the banner the guild sat in the grass of the old ward, some hundreds of us, with our chisels in our laps. Thin as ash lay the last light on the snow. On the wall the soldiers shouted for the banner. In the grass we said naught.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo ull re reskym, eth nath re yal prassoth lom tul veth lymmyl nynth. Re orrom et hiskenneth susk lo sest luld et Stonwrytan, sa re wysk piskur somm re orr o. Gor vess re aedhym lo o sest.
english: There sat I, that had no craft yet but the carrying of water. Over the high passes I had walked beside a boy of the guild, that knotted a net as he went. At night I slept at his side.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellorom ul et parow ull hosel.
english: I came into that courtyard alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Fedh lyss ul en sestow re rarra pa dhev, sona yarlath cemmet: Enno eth Della, sa re yal lesknoth grem lonta. Nath re yyst ganna tunn hy et tevath et brunn, veth sona. Re reske sona olen, eth nath re luska sona.
english: A little after me came two children with their hands joined, Enno and Della, of fifteen winters. Of the children's pairs, none came up the mountain whole save those two. They sat down together, and held on.

label: Romanisation
rom: Noth cumm, re vesker so ul sennyl ul murr bress. Re orrar dem neld hyont, hos eth hos, eth et bresketh ul ol havulath. Re wemm nahos hyor garl, hy vodh re nalusk et daevarat o: Gald; nath nayald. Par; nath mosk. Nath re yal hespeth lor veth lodh eth bresk, eth nath re yal so loskat.
english: Ten havens had we watched die in twenty months. From each we walked away with our chisels in our packs. No hand had we lifted, for our creed forbade it: *Build, do not destroy. Protect, do not attack.* Mortar and chisel were our only arms, and they had not been enough.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re resk vennoth relv tesk umor tul, hosen covv thenth. Re yal gor hos hy et hemmeth lo ull ul gylyl hos galat duss: haldath galdat dem sollan, ul et dask doss maver so hethyl lo lorr. Eth amm ew hosen ull, cedh sa hebb et lorr? Cedh sa wemm et garlath?
english: The faith of twelve generations sat on us yet, like a wet cloak. Every elder there turned over the same hard thing: that walls raised for peace must at the last be held with blood. And if that were so, whose blood? Whose hands?

label: Romanisation
rom: Halyna, nath re seskym sona amm ull, veth hosen Hemm eth Hemma sa re reske hy ullen ul vimm et ganna ulvenn cresket, eth re wrodha lo nahos, hy vodh nath re yal maver lonta. Re hadhant ey gedheth et ganna ull. Re stannant o yedheth o dholm hy et brunn. Ew humm eth verr sona, eth hos hy et tevow.
english: {{Halyna}} I knew not then, save as two elders that sat apart under the broken inner gate, and spake to no one, for they had no need. Her line had laid that gate. His had cut its stone out of the mountain. Husband and wife they were, and one since the cradle.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re rarr et Crenn dem vimm hy et hald. Re veskym et covv ul daldol, eth nath re seskym vodh ew o dem et Stonwrytan. New susk o. Re yal brenthromm um nindeth et Crenn tul, eth saed hovv um o sestow. Re vesk o um et hemmeth, eth hyont um et ganna cresket, eth re vess o hos pessyl. El sy o wrodan hosel sa ross myskyl pawast lo et odh sy:
english: Then came the Captain down from the wall. I had seen the cloak go up, and wist not what it was to us. Not tall was he. The coal-black was yet on his fingers, and the half of a cloak on his back. He looked at the elders, and past them at the broken gate, and asked one question. It is the only speech of his that any at this hearth can say over:

label: Romanisation
rom: Ommant va haldath. Es naldos, ell es veskys eth es sennys?
english: "Your walls are falling. Will you build, or will you watch and die?"

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhess nahos o. Tumom et helvhoss ul et linth.
english: No one answered him. I remember the wind in the grass.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re dhalda Halyna.
english: Then {{Halyna}} stood up.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et covv treskat re veske sona dem susk, eth re ferre sona dem et movenn ul hos hoss. Re dhaldant sona wresketh hosen hos.
english: To the torn cloak they looked up, and bowed to it in the same breath. Up went their chisels as one.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rike et pa wresk et baegyth dasken.
english: Their two chisels took the last of the light.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh ey tolm hosast et carm, eth re hadh o et hosk umo:
english: She began the cry, and he ended it:

label: Romanisation
rom: Carm et lodh hy et trun. Talda, Stonwrytan! Cadha tolm um dholm. Stona gor hald dem et dask sost,
english: "The mortar cries out from the ground. Rise, Stonewrights! Lay stone upon stone. Stand every wall to the very end."

label: Romanisation
rom: Talda! Talda! Talda!
english: "Rise! Rise! Rise!"

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew hos carm o, ul ba hossow. New hosast ey veth hy vodh doss maver tolm hosast um harm. Brodhant merr o: Re harm ey, eth re dhess o, eth velvyth ul sona lodh.
english: One cry it was, in two throats. Hers came first for no cause but that a cry must begin somewhere. Some tell it that she called and he answered, with a silence between.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re yal velvyth.
english: There was no silence.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re dhald et Stonwrytan, hosen crernil amm drunnant et stomorn hyo: gor dholm um ullen. Re dhaldom ulont, eth nath dumom et taldol. Re riker et carm, eth re rikent et hesperdeth um et hald o hyor, eth re rik lunt et trenn o hyont.
english: Then stood the guild, like an arch when the frame is struck from under it, every stone on its neighbour. I stood with them, and remember not the standing. We took up the cry, and the soldiers on the wall took it from us, and the column from the soldiers.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath marr tolm hemm. Ul vimm misk re ledhym o ul marrol.
english: Old stone trembleth not. Under my feet I felt it tremble.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess ull re yal vorr lo et odh sy, et hosast ul surrath mest hy nydhyl. Lo et vorr re yalda Idrenna et haethil lo et Crenn, eth re lymmym et nynth. Niss re wrodha sona, hosen brodh et hemman, eth nath re vynt et Crenn sona.
english: That night this hearth had its first fire in more years than any could tell. By it {{Idrenna}} made the terms with the Captain, and I carried in the water. Slow they spake, as the old speak, and the Captain hurried them not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath lymm et Stonwrytan hespeth, eth nath re vess et Crenn o. Veth es nald et Stonwrytan ul lodh et sevireth, eth es glenn vathur ul vimm et brammath. Hy ull ston et haethil tul, lo wrodath et Stonwrytan sost: lo vyntyth eth gandoth sa re yal lo Lodhan Helv hosel. Hy ull re hebbe Idrenna o lo, ul ba saed:
english: The Stonewrights would bear no arms, and he asked it not. But they would build between the volleys, and mend a breach under the guns. So the terms stand yet, in the guild's own words: *with the speed and precision that only Aetherbonded pairs could achieve*. Then {{Idrenna}} gave it him in two halves:

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel et hesp, veth et tolm.
english: "Not the sword, but the stone."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel et hurrol, veth et kethyl.
english: "Not the killing, but the keeping."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ferr et Crenn. El brod et Stonwrytan o amm sy.
english: The Captain bowed his head. It is the guild's word now.

label: Romanisation
rom: Somm nath re senn et vorr ull tul, re dhreske Orvenna et tynurorl ul sull, hosen treskent stannardath kyvildholm lo dhrenn o dhresk sost. Dem et Crenn re vyske sona:
english: Ere that fire burned down, {{Orvenna}} split the siege day in three, as quarrymen split a block along its own seam. To the Captain they said:

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor wramm caldat los, trenn nahadhat lor,
english: "Every gun ye haul is a course we lay not,"

label: Romanisation
rom: hy ull vyssora bramm hosen vyssor uld vothen lenn.
english: "so spend a gun as a careful man spendeth silver."

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull re vellent et tolmardath, hosen vellent o tul:
english: *Then the masons sang, as they sing it still:*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Cadha et tolm somm sol et wadh pondul,
english:
*Lay the stone while the sea lies bare,*
*haul the gun while the guns are cold,*
*hold the wall when the grey sails come,*
*and the wall will hold.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: calda et bramm somm brid et bramm,
english:
*Lay the stone while the sea lies bare,*
*haul the gun while the guns are cold,*
*hold the wall when the grey sails come,*
*and the wall will hold.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: ketha et hald amm mellorant wemmeth myst,
english:
*Lay the stone while the sea lies bare,*
*haul the gun while the guns are cold,*
*hold the wall when the grey sails come,*
*and the wall will hold.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: eth es geth et hald.
english:
*Lay the stone while the sea lies bare,*
*haul the gun while the guns are cold,*
*hold the wall when the grey sails come,*
*and the wall will hold.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Eth amm veskys stonwrytel um et hald ul et kethyl, veska pawast. Es veskys pa.
english: And wherever ye see a Stonewright on the wall in the holding, look again. Ye will see two.

label: Romanisation
rom: Desir ul et vess ull, lo dhymornath sa re vedhent ul et frenn sa omm, re hadhar trenn hosast et gorrol ul dresk et ganna ulvenn. Re hresker gor wrellir um et brellir ul vimm. Dem vell hemm et ganna, sa re vellent et cummath, re vesse Orvenna et carmath baeg sost hyor. Re dhalda Enno eth Della, eth re rike et carm hosast ul sona lodh, hos dem et hessel, eth ullen et ullen.
english: Late that night, by torches that hissed in the falling frost, we laid the first course of the war in the gap of the inner gate. Every joint we broke over the joint below. For the old gate-song of the havens {{Orvenna}} asked the clearest voices. Up stood Enno and Della, and took the first voice between them, the one to the comma and the other the rest.

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull re velle sona, eth et Stonwrytan ul sona sestow:
english: *Then they sang, and the guild after them:*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Tolm um dholm, eth keth et tolm vennoth;
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: garl um yarl, eth keth et garl venn;
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: pa lo yanna, amm cemment wemmeth myst,
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: pa lo yanna, eth ston et ganna tunn.
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellym dem et hessel, eth hy ull re vellym et ullen.
english: I sang to the comma, and then I sang the rest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re yal et tymornath lyss, re aedhe Enno eth Della lo et trenn clenn, sona yarlath cemmet tul, hosen re yyste sona et brunn. Re solom hy ullen, lo et nunthath nynth, eth re aedhym.
english: When the torches were stubs, Enno and Della lay asleep against the new course, their hands yet joined, as they had come up the mountain. I lay down a little way off, by the water-pails, and slept.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem ryst re hyn et lodh.
english: By morning the mortar had set.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Hoss Sell et Crenn
english: I.3 · The Captain's Long Breath

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et grem hosast, ul o wress pawast.
english: *The first winter, in its second month.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Hale Haskard, sa re yal dhomnoth surr lo, eth ul o ryndeth hosast um et hald. Re wrodh o et trenn ul stonol, eth pynt hosen re hask o fedh; re hadhom o niss.
english: *Laid by Hale the runner, that was seventeen and in his first weeks on the wall. He told it standing, and as fast as ever he ran; I have set it down slower.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom, hy ull. Nel brodhard en. Haskom.
english: Give me the stone, then. I am not a teller. I run.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal tolm haskardath lo et cummath, cumm eth cumm. Ol dolm, re yaldar o ul et dynd hosast, hy dholm ommat lo et ganna ulvenn; eth umo re ryter et ryt hemm:
english: Every haven had its runners' stone. Ours we made the first week, of a fallen block by the inner gate, and on it we sware the old oath:

label: Romanisation
rom: Galat sa re veskym, lymmym o. Nath lymmym galat ullen. Ston.
english: "What I saw, I carry. I carry nothing else."

label: Romanisation
rom: Dasken re ryt Wik o, et tevel sost hyor eth et pynt sost. Nath re vall Wik galat gell hy lymmyl wrod dem et Crenn.
english: Wick sware it last, the youngest of us and the swiftest. Naught would he sooner do than carry a word to the Captain.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul myst ryst et kiser hosast re stonom lo et brammath sa nesk Kael, gor yalat sa ross lor tul. Re hunn Kael kaever et Crenn: ul vodh es nend o, pedh vodh es gadh o, eth amm vodh es geth o. Hy ull re orr et Crenn dem neld, dem nask et hald. Re hadh Kael o yarl um en sest.
english: At the grey of the morning of the first assault I stood by Kael's guns, that are yet all we have. The Captain gave Kael his mind: where to watch, what shot to lay, and when to hold. Then went he on, to the far end of the wall. Kael laid his hand on my shoulder.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath gyl kaever ull veth o harm sost lo en sest, luld; eth nath noss stonol lo uld veth ul hos reskow.
english: "Naught may change that mind but his own voice at my side, lad, and a man can stand but in one place."

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull re vyskent et cryrullath et sull carm, pawast eth pawast, hosen myskent tul:
english: *Then the troops drilled the three calls, as they drill them still:*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Marr tho dhrun, eth nend nynth clenn;
english:
*Shift your ground, and watch new water;*
*change your shot for the sea, the shore, the sky;*
*hold, or loose, when the Captain is by.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: kyl tho vedh dem et wadh, et orrow, et helv;
english:
*Shift your ground, and watch new water;*
*change your shot for the sea, the shore, the sky;*
*hold, or loose, when the Captain is by.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: keth, ell lusk, amm doss et Crenn lo sest.
english:
*Shift your ground, and watch new water;*
*change your shot for the sea, the shore, the sky;*
*hold, or loose, when the Captain is by.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re dhunnant, re ferr Yory Dhavow Hemm um hosk et hald rerddhalden, eth re hossvell et vell sa dhevirent et higileth hemm. Lo visk et bystir re yal Merrik ul scaevurol wunth, et hemm sost hyont. Re vysk o lo: Hess. Re dhyvull Yory dem vimm umo.
english: The drill done, Jory of Eldhythe leaned on the parapet of the east wall and whistled a tune that the old ship-masters hate. Merrick, eldest of them, coiling rope at the stair-foot, bade him stop. Jory laughed down at him.

label: Romanisation
rom: El hosel tevvell o.
english: "It is only a rhyme."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re dhyvull Merrik.
english: Merrick did not laugh.

label: Romanisation
rom: Somm nath re orr saed et ryst tul, re rarrant wemmeth en gethyl hosast hy et myst, pynt hy en nydhyl. Ul et cadhol orrant et clemeth niss, hy vodh doss tolm nalelv, eth ul et caldol, niss hy ull. Ul et kethyl orr clem ul moltrunn.
english: Ere the morning was half gone, the sails of my first holding came out of the grey faster than I could tell them. In the laying the hours go slow, for stone is heavy, and in the hauling slower. In the holding an hour is gone in a heartbeat.

label: Romanisation
rom: Desir ul et kethyl, amm re yal et ullen vyssorat eth re yal et tolmardath um et vathur, re vesk begorn et bramman scethel ul sirr dem neld sa re rasor Pellow. Re dhovv o ul sestow ul et myst, ul vodh nath re dhovv hos fedh. Amm ull re vellor o, desir eth hosel.
english: Late in the holding, when the rest were spent and the masons were come out on the breach, Kael's lookout saw a hull in a far-glass of Pellow's grinding. It had hung back in the grey, where none had hung before. Now it came in, late and alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lodh et Crenn eth et scethel ull re sol et dhidh. Re hebb Kael sull brod lom.
english: Between the Captain and that hull lay the smoke. Kael gave me three words.

label: Romanisation
rom: Scethel ul sestow.
english: "Hull hangeth back."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re haskom o.
english: I ran it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Haskom. Ul vimm et dhidh, bisk dem vimm, ul neld et tolmardath, ul neld et bunthath. Myskym dem nahos, eth nath hessym. Dem susk, dem et baegyth, ul susk et ganna.
english: I run. Under the smoke, head down, past the masons, past the ropes. To no man speak I, and I stop not. Up into the clear, above the gate.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ston et Crenn sol.
english: The Captain standeth still.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tumom ull hosast. Re yal gor yalat um et hald ull ul morrol; nath re yal o. Re heth o hosk et hald lo hos garl, eth o lern dem et wadh. Nath re vesk o umom. Veth re hunn o gor wrod, dem et brod dasken.
english: That is what I remember first. Everything on that wall was moving but him. One hand he had on the parapet, his face to the sea. He looked not round at me. Yet he heard me to the last word.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re orr o dem et brammath sa nesk Kael, lo o lusul sost, eth en lo o sest. Somm re orr o, re yal et clem ul sellyl.
english: Then he walked toward Kael's guns at his own pace, and I at his shoulder. As he walked, the hour began to stretch.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re hess et clem pynt. Re orr o niss, hosen saevar dholmath um wrunnel sell, dem et fedh sa re yal nydhyl yannath et scaevur lo luld ul sestow. Nath noss cadhol gell hy sy lom.
english: It stopped not short. It slowed, like a stone-cart on a long hill, till a boy behind might count the spokes. I have no better way to say it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re veskym et nynth ul vidhyl hy lern et scethel desir. Re nydhym et fodheleth ul morrol dem vimm lo dhrenn et wemm myst, hosen nydhys scaevurath um et mesk stinet: hos, eth hy ull ullen. Ew clemel gor hos, kaeverym. Re solant et nasath wadh. Re ston et dhidh. Re orr o tul.
english: I saw the water sheet off the late hull's bow. I counted the ripples going down its grey sail, as ye count the rings on a cut log: one, and then the next. Each, I think, was a minute. The gulls hung. The smoke stood. On he walked.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal fedh ludalol lom. Hy ull re yal fedh haemul lom um ull. Hy ull re yal fedh hessyl lom.
english: I had time to be afraid. Then I had time to be ashamed of it. Then I had time to stop.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hess o, eth re yal Kael lo o sest. Re yal Kael ul nydhyl ul vimm o hoss. Hy ull re hebb et Crenn et carm, lo o harm sost.
english: At Kael's shoulder he stopped. Kael was counting under his breath. Then the Captain gave the call, with his own voice.

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth.
english: "Hold."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth et bramman. Ul vimm re hadhant et tolmardath tul, pa eth pa, eth nath re veskent dem susk. Re rarr et scethel desir tul lo dhrenn et dhidh, eth tul, dem et fedh sa re yal veskyl et nynth um o hrynireth lom.
english: The battery held. Below us the masons laid on, two and two, and looked not up. The late hull came on through the smoke, and on, till I could see the wet on its timbers.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lusk.
english: "Loose."

label: Romanisation
rom: Niss re lusk et clem ol, hosen orr hoss kethet hyo. Re wrammant et brammath. Ul et dhidh re hresk et scethel, ul hosel reskow et nynth ull ul vodh nath re yal grest hyo um hos, ul vodh re haever et Crenn o dem greskyl.
english: The hour let us go, slow, like a held breath going out. The guns went. Out in the smoke the hull broke up, in the one stretch of that water where it could hurt no one, where the Captain had meant it to break.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath seskym vodh re haever et Crenn. Seskym vodh re yald o.
english: I know not what the Captain thought. I know what he did.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hedh ull re orrom et hylldhrenn, hosen orrar, ol haskardath, ul sestow gor hethyl. Ul et venth re veskym rellorath rytet ul grynir, eth re lymmym so dem susk ul neld et vorrath, dem Halyna:
english: That evening I walked the tide-line, as we runners do after every holding. In the shallows I saw marks cut in a plank, and carried them up past the fires to {{Halyna}}:

label: Romanisation
rom: Rellorath um et mesk.
english: "Marks on the wood."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re haskom o.
english: I ran it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess ull re vymmym lo reller Hesk, greller o odha, um hald et bridlern. Hyo re seskym: gern et bridlern.
english: That night I found my way back by Hesk's lamp, his mother's lamp, on the north wall. By it I wist the north was awake.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy myskent et uldath o lo dhrenn et hald: Lo et Crenn, clem sell hosen orl. Kaeverym re hadhom o dholm hosast, veth mysk Voss: Doss et brodhat hemm hyoth. Myskent o hosen amm re hebb et Ternil o lo. Re vyskym o hosen ull, en sost; eth amm sy seskym gell hy ull. Re hlenn Kael o, eth lymmym o hosen re vysk o, eth nath lymmym galat ullen:
english: Now the men say it along the wall: "For the Captain, an hour lasteth as long as a day." I think it began with me, though Voss will have it older. They say it as though the Rite had given it him. So said I myself, and I know better now. Kael mended it, and I carry it as he said it, and nothing else:

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel et trun sa orr niss, luld. El et Crenn sa nath bynt. Et clemel sa re naelur o, ew et clemel sa re rarr.
english: "It is not the world that sloweth, lad. It is the Captain who will not hurry. The moment he chose was the moment that came."

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
